verses.text: You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your mână with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not favor a poor man in his cause. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey să pleceing astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the țară of Egipt.
For six years you shall sow your țară, and shall gather in its increase,

but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Be careful to do all things that I have i-a zis lui you; and don’t invoke the name of other să pleceds or even let them be heard out of your mouth.
You shall observe a feast to me three times a year. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egipt), and no one shall appear before me empty. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu. You shall not boil a young să pleceat in its mother’s milk.
Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For my angel shall să plece before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
You shall not bow down to their să pleceds, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.
You shall serve the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
No one will miscarry or be barren in your țară. I will fulfill the number of your days.
I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the țară become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the țară.

I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the țară into your mână, and you shall drive them out before you.
You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their să pleceds.
They shall not dwell in your țară, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their să pleceds, it will surely be a snare to you.
